ValidationRule.description: Security-labelled tasks cannot be Minor, Database work needs Backend, and label counts are capped by severity.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Labels__c)), OR( AND(INCLUDES(Labels__c, 'Security'), ISPICKVAL(Severity__c, 'Minor')), AND(INCLUDES(Labels__c, 'Database'), NOT(INCLUDES(Labels__c, 'Backend'))), PICKLISTCOUNT(Labels__c) > IF(ISPICKVAL(Severity__c, 'Blocker'), 5, 3) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Labels and severity are not consistent.
